in_marathi.name: Ojaswini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Vitality, Energy, Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ojaswini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ojaswini is a Sanskrit name for a girl, derived from the word ‘Ojas’ which means ‘vitality, energy, and power’. In Hindu mythology, Ojaswini is considered a form of the goddess Durga, who represents strength, power, and courage. This name is believed to bring prosperity, happiness, and good fortune to the bearer.
